introHtml: Orange lanyards and badges are a practical choice for safety managers and event coordinators who need high-visibility identification. Whether you're managing a construction site, a marathon, or a conference, orange stands out in crowds and low-light conditions. Choose from 1" knit-in or 3/4" woven styles with custom imprinting, or opt for antimicrobial lanyards for healthcare environments. Perfect for bulk orders where visibility and branding go hand in hand.
